name: Jefferson Curl
instructions: Stand on a bench or box holding a very light barbell at your thighs, with your legs straight.
Slowly tuck your chin and round your spine one segment at a time, lowering the bar toward your toes.
Reach your deepest comfortable range, then reverse the movement, stacking your spine back up one vertebra at a time.
Use a very light load and move slowly. This is for mobility and spinal control, not heavy lifting.
image_prompt_scene: Standing tall on a bench holding a light barbell at the thighs.
